episodes.title: Taking Notes
episodes.description: Thomas Frank covers preparing for class and choosing a note-taking approach that supports recall and later review.

episodes.title: Reading Assignments
episodes.description: Learn how to prioritize assigned reading and approach a large reading workload with a practical strategy.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.description: Explore how memory operates and adapt your study habits to its strengths and constraints.

episodes.title: Planning & Organization
episodes.description: Build a planning and organization system that helps you use your available study time effectively.

episodes.title: Focus & Concentration
episodes.description: Understand study distractions and develop habits that strengthen your ability to stay focused.

episodes.title: Procrastination
episodes.description: Explore ways to overcome the urge to put off studying, writing, and other important work.

episodes.title: Studying for Exams
episodes.description: Thomas Frank introduces effective exam preparation strategies as an alternative to last-minute cramming.

episodes.title: Test Anxiety
episodes.description: Learn ways to manage exam-related fear and arrive on test day feeling calmer and more confident.

episodes.title: Papers & Essays
episodes.description: Find a starting point for research papers, organize your writing process, and avoid getting stuck in endless research.

episodes.title: Exercise
episodes.description: The final lesson connects physical well-being with learning, explaining why caring for your body also supports your brain.
